Future<void> run(items, read) async {
 Object? saved;
 for (final item in items) { saved ??= await read(); }
 for (final item in items) {
  var row = cache[item];
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  row ??= await read(item);
 }
 for (final item in items) {
  saved = null;
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  if (saved == null) saved = await read(item);
 }
 for (final group in items) {
  String? blocking;
  for (final item in group) {
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
   blocking ??= await read(item);
  }
 }
 var cursor = 'start';
 for (final item in items) {
  cursor = await next(cursor, item);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  rows[item] = await enrich(rows[item]);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  item.field = await refresh(item.field);
 }
}
Future<void> resetByAwait(items, read) async {
 Object? saved;
 for (final item in items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  saved = await refresh(item);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  saved ??= await read(item);
 }
}
Future<void> unrelatedReset(items, read) async {
 Object? saved;
 for (final item in items) {
  count = item;
  if (saved == null) saved = await read();
 }
}
